fusions.name: Line of Sight
fusions.desc: Throws a knife that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Marked] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Where the Gaze Rests
fusions.desc: Stabs the target for 28 damage and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. It is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Held by a Look
fusions.desc: Your stare holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 2 seconds and leaves them [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Every Tell Noted
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 8. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: a second blow strikes it for 20% of your weapon damage per stack (163% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
